name: margaryan-content-studio
description: Create and revise editable motion-graphics film storyboards from ChatGPT without an OpenAI API key; preview and render with Margaryan Motion Studio.

interface.shortDescription: Make editable motion videos from a ChatGPT conversation
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT directs the storyboard and edits, while the existing browser-based Motion Studio previews and exports procedurally rendered video. No OpenAI API key required for these tools.
defaultPrompt: Create a 30-second vertical motion-graphics video for my business.
Revise the second shot in my existing Motion Studio video.
